% Testaments: a full-page-width divider, TOC section level.
\newcommand{\xchapter}[1]{%

% Books: new page, TOC subsection level.
\newcommand{\xsection}[1]{%
  \clearpage\phantomsection\addcontentsline{toc}{subsection}{#1}%

   \raggedright #1\par}%
